comment: Gold corpus for the Project Intelligence retrieval evaluation. items seed the canonical knowledge store; queries assert which item ids a task-shaped question must retrieve in its top K. Extend with distilled real-repository lessons as they accumulate — the harness (TestRetrievalQualityEval) recomputes recall@K and the inactive-leak rate on every build.

items.title: Scheduler slot release
items.statement: Scheduler slots must be released in a finally block after every turn, or the API lane deadlocks under load.

items.title: Split is the unit
items.statement: A split is the smallest schedulable unit of work; stages group splits and never schedule below them.

items.title: Connector SPI frozen
items.statement: Connector SPI signatures must not change within a release line; plugins compiled against it must keep loading.

items.title: Dialog copy style
items.statement: Dialog buttons use sentence case and never end with a period.

items.title: Unconfirmed scheduler hunch
items.statement: Scheduler retries might double-count slot budgets in rare paths.

items.title: Old scheduler advice
items.statement: Scheduler slots used to be pooled per thread; tune the pool size when latency spikes.

queries.query: fix a deadlock when the agent scheduler runs many API turns
refactor the Connector SPI interface method signatures
add a confirmation dialog to the frontend
